jutsuBookImport.sourceText:
Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Touch Duration: Until Restored
Components: HS, CM, CS Cost: 14 Chakra Keywords: Genjutsu, Fuinjutsu Description: You attempt to reshape another creature’s memories. One creature that you touch must make an Intelligence saving throw. If you are fighting the creature, it has advantage on the saving throw. On a failed save, the target becomes Charmed by you for 1 minute. The Charmed target is Incapacitated and unaware of its surroundings, though it can still hear you. If it takes any damage or is targeted by another jutsu, this jutsu ends, and none of the target’s memories are modified. While this charm lasts, you can affect the target’s memory of an event that it experienced within the last 12 Months and that lasted no more than 1 Day.
You can Temporarily overwrite all memory of the event, allow the target to recall the event with perfect clarity and exacting detail, change its memory of the details of the event, or create a memory of some other event.
You must speak to the target to describe how its memories are affected and it must be able to understand your language for the modified memories to take root. Its mind fills in any gaps in the details of your description. If the jutsu ends before you have finished describing the modified memories, the creature’s memory isn’t altered.
The modified memories take hold when the jutsu ends. A modified memory doesn’t necessarily affect how a creature behaves, particularly if the memory contradicts the creature’s natural inclinations, allegiance, or beliefs. An illogical modified memory is dismissed, perhaps as a bad dream. The DM might deem a modified memory too nonsensical to affect a creature in a significant manner.
A Genjutsu Break or Greater Restorative Jutsu cast on the target, specifically intended to restore the creature’s true memory will restore the memory.

Rank: D-Rank Casting Time: 1 Bonus Action Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Components: HS, CM Cost: 5 Chakra Keywords: Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile)  Description: You conjure illusionary weapons made of darkness and fear that can rend through a creature’s mental defense.
You manifest a weapon of your description that you are proficient in that lasts for the duration called a Shadow Blade. If you lose possession of it, it disappears but can be evoked again at no action cost on your turn. This weapon is an illusion but feel real to their targets. You can use this special weapon as an Action on your turn.
Shadow Blade. Make a melee or ranged Genjutsu attack against a target creature. Each attack type deals its listed damage, its listed range and has a +1 bonus to their critical threat range.
Melee. Range of 5 feet, and on a hit, you deal 3d6 psychic damage. On a critical hit the affected creature must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Ranged. Range of 60 feet and on a hit, you deal 2d6 psychic damage.  On a critical hit the affected creature must make an Intelligence saving throw.
Success: Affected creature resists this Jutsu’s effect.
Failure: Affected creatures gains 1 rank of Demoralized or Shaken.
Critical Failure: Affect creatures gain 1 rank of both Demoralized or Shaken.
At Higher Ranks: For each rank you cast this jutsu above D-Rank, increase the cost of this jutsu by 3. If this jutsu is Cast at C-Rank or higher, you can add your Genjutsu ability modifier to the Shadow Blades damage. If this jutsu is cast at B-Rank, you can make two attacks instead of one. If this jutsu is cast at A-Rank or higher, attacks with the Shadow Blade gain an additional +1 bonus to its critical threat range. If this jutsu is cast at S-Rank, you can make three attacks instead of one.

Rank: S-Rank Casting Time: 1 Action Range: Self (60-foot radius) Duration: Concentration, Up to 1 Minute
Components: HS, CM
Cost: 30 Chakra Keywords: Genjutsu (Visual, Tactile), Kinjutsu Description: You create an illusory mirage of angry, ferocious, man-eating rabbits with glowing red eyes that follow you and attack all creatures of your choice within range.
As an action on each of your turns, you can make a melee genjutsu attack against up to 4 creatures you can see within range. On a hit, the swarm of rabbits attack the creature biting and tearing into them, ripping pieces from their flesh and ferociously holding them down. You deal psychic damage equal to 27d4 and the target creature must make a Charisma saving throw.
On a failed save they gain 3 ranks of Demoralized against you for 1 minute and are Restrained until the end of their next turn.
If you make a melee genjutsu attack against a Restrained creature using this jutsu, you reroll all 1’s, taking the second result.

Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Reaction, which you take when you would gain a Mental or Sensory condition as the result of failing a saving throw, caused by a Genjutsu. Range: 60 feet Duration: Instant
Components:  HS, CM Cost: 11 Chakra Keywords: Genjutsu (Visual) Description: You coat your mind in a chakra designed to be malleable and reflect change well. When you would gain a mental or sensory condition you can bounce it back to any hostile creature within range.
Target creature must make an Intelligence saving throw.
Success: Affected creature is able to resist this jutsu’s effects.
Failure: Affected creature gains whatever Mental or Sensory conditions you would gain as if they failed their own saving throw.
Critical Failure: Affected creature suffers the same effects of a Failure, and also cannot remove the condition themselves and instead must spend an action to remake this jutsu’s saving throw to end them.

Rank: B-Rank Casting Time: 1 Minute Range: Touch Duration: Permanent
Components: HS, CM, CS Cost: 14 Chakra Keywords: Genjutsu, Fuinjutsu Description: As a part of the activation of this jutsu. The
target must currently be Incapacitated or willing. Over the course of a minute, you tattoo a seal on a target creatures’ tongue. You select 1 topic, which you wish for the target creature to be unable to speak of. Once this jutsu is casted the target creature becomes unable to speak, write, or willing reveal information on or about the topic you chose. A creature can attempt to undo the effects of this jutsu by making a Ninshou check against your Genjutsu Save DC + 5. An affected creature cannot gain a bonus to this check as the result of a jutsu. Each attempt takes 1 hour. On a successful check the target creature becomes able to speak on the topic freely again.
